title: Sethite theory adopted by Jews and by the church through Augustine

tellings.quote: verse. And and what they did was uh they said that the the sons of God in Genesis 6 that that populated with the daughters of Adam that these were noble men from the line of Seth

plain: In Genesis 6, which the King James Bible of 1611 renders as "the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair" and "there were giants in the earth in those days," the sons of God were later explained away as noble men from the family line of Seth, Adam's son. The filmmaker Tim Alberino tells Michels that Jewish teachers took up this reading, and that the church took it up through Saint Augustine. He tells it to argue that the original meaning, beings from heaven fathering giants, was covered over. The verse itself does not say who the sons of God were, which is why both readings have found room in it.
